info.title: milli API
info.description: Generated from the actual Fastify route inventory and shared Zod contracts. Domain refinements, ownership and revision/fence checks also run on the server. Native password signup/signin are provided separately by the restricted Better Auth Next.js proxy at /api/auth; see docs/phase-6-deployment.md. No generated examples contain learner data or credentials.

get.summary: Stream one owned lesson utterance
get.description: Requires matching Origin and a start frame with sessionId and bearer token, validated before speech-provider work. JSON follows DictationStreamClientSchema and DictationStreamServerSchema. Send mono PCM16 at 16 kHz after ready, then finish. Audio limit 30 seconds, authentication deadline five seconds, connection limit 45 seconds.
